inputs.prompt: The person from <Picture 1>, exactly as they look in the photo: the same face, eye shape, nose, lips, skin texture with natural pores, no beauty filter, no smoothing, no idol makeup, not stylised. Hair exactly like <Picture 2>: dry, matte, airy, fluffy platinum blonde, evenly blonde all over from root to tip, no dark roots, no dark streaks, no dark underlayer; a short choppy textured shag with piecey, uneven, feathered ends and choppy bangs. Not wet, not oily, not shiny, not slicked. Only the hair comes from <Picture 2>; the face, piercings and earring come from <Picture 1>. Piercings exactly as in the photo, both always visible: a small silver septum clicker ring in the nose, and a small silver hoop lip ring through the lower lip, slightly off-centre. The same pearl hoop earring. Natural matte rose-nude lips, no lipstick, no gloss. Body: androgynous slim build with a small, flat chest; never enlarge the chest. Outfit: an oversized pale-blue and white striped button-up shirt worn as a shirt-dress, sleeves pushed up, a thin black necktie loosened, big silver over-ear headphones around the neck, white knee-high socks, chunky black shoes. Medium close-up inside an old photo booth with a red velvet curtain, sitting square to the camera, deadpan stare straight into the lens, chin slightly down. Direct on-camera flash snapshot, harsh flash with soft shadow on the curtain, slightly blown highlights, 35mm film grain, real photograph like a cult music video still. Almost still: one slow blink, the camera does not move.
